property_summary: For any owner caller and any withdraw amount, calling withdraw(...) either successfully transfers that much out (making address(c).balance decrease) — the reference always results in address(c).balance < prior balance after a withdraw that sends value — whereas the mutant that makes withdraw a no-op can produce a case where the call returns (doesn't revert) but address(c).balance remains unchanged; the test asserts that after owner calls withdraw(amount) the contract balance is strictly less than before, which holds for the reference and is violated by the mutant for some inputs.
change_summary: Delete the transfer so withdraw becomes a no-op (does not send ether), changing observed balance after call.
